title: 第849章 烛冥昪玦第848章 却也不够聪明
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 高空魔族正想说什么，突然一道身影从蓝色屏障内冲了出来。
身影旁边的妖被吓了一跳，伸手想拦，可意外的是，身影只有化神初阶修为，却跑的比化神圆满还快。
群妖还以为身影被吓疯了，想去跟高空的魔族拼命。
谁料，身影站在巨大眼睛下，神情难掩的惊喜，因过于的激动几次张口都没能发出声音，不得不深呼吸缓和了一下心情。
“这般精纯的魔气，您，您是渊魔族的大人！”
魔族也是有等级的，最高级别是天魔，接下来便是渊魔。
妖族总说他们血脉差别大，其实魔族等级同样划分严苛，魔气精纯程度决定他们在魔族的阶层，魔气纯度高的魔族甚至可以用魔气控制不如他们的魔族。
身影想了想。
渊魔族，实力强……
脑海闪过一个令他都万分错愕的名字。
“您，您和烛冥昪玦大人什么关系？”
众妖懵了，脑子宕机一样，他们看着身影背影的眼神跟看鬼一样。
千万别告诉他们，他们心中的想法是真的？
冲出去的这道身影，不会也是魔族族人吧？
搞什么啊？说好的界域屏障呢？有一个至高魔族出现，莫名其妙能操控栖灵宝境也就算了，怎么又跑出一个化神初级的魔族？
当他们妖界是菜市场，想来就来，想走就走啊？
祖临戈凝视不远处的身影，片刻后道，“他不是魔族，不，不全是魔族，他的身体是妖，可他的灵魂是魔族的灵魂。”
祖临戈说的很清楚了，身影原本是妖，可是被魔族不知用何方法夺舍了。
群妖原以为他们已经够愤怒了，可听到祖临戈话，他们又怒又慌又急。
任谁看到和自己同界的人被其他界域的人夺舍都会慌，这意味着他们妖界出现了魔族的卧底。
谁敢说，妖界就这一个卧底？
他们甚至无法确定，此刻自己身边还有没有魔族的卧底。
魔族这是什么意思？跟修真界发动大战还不够，现在将主意打在他们妖界身上了是吗？
也不看看自己有没有那么大的胃口。
他们不同族群彼此间是斗得厉害，可若是有人妄图侵蚀妖界的地盘，他们也会团结对外。
他们很想将魔族有卧底的消息传遍妖界，让每一个族群都提起精神，可被困这里，他们除了干着急什么都做不了。
就是林筱也难得露出点惊讶。
content_en:
The high-altitude demon was about to say something when suddenly a figure rushed out from the blue barrier.
The demon next to the figure was startled, and stretched out his hand to stop him, but to his surprise, the figure only had the preliminary level of God Transformation, but he ran faster than the perfect God Transformation.
The group of demons thought that the figure was frightened and went crazy, and wanted to fight the demons high in the sky.
Unexpectedly, the figure stood under the huge eyes, with an expression of surprise that could not be concealed. Because he was too excited, he opened his mouth several times and was unable to make a sound, so he had to take a deep breath to calm down.
"Such pure demonic energy, you, you are the master of the Abyss Demon Tribe!"
Demons also have levels. The highest level is the Heavenly Demon, followed by the Abyss Demon.
Demons always say that their bloodlines are very different. In fact, the levels of demons are also strictly divided. The purity of their demonic energy determines their level in the demon clan. Demons with high purity of demonic energy can even use demonic energy to control demons that are inferior to them.
The figure thought for a moment.
The Abyss Demon Clan is powerful...
A name flashed through his mind that made him extremely surprised.
"You, what is your relationship with Mr. Zhu Mingmingjue?"
The demons were stunned, their minds were shut down, and they looked at the back of the figure as if they were looking at ghosts.
Don't tell them, is what they are thinking true?
Isn't this figure who rushed out also a member of the Demon Clan?
What are you doing? What about the promised boundary barrier? There was a supreme demon clan who appeared, and it was inexplicably able to control the spirit-dwelling treasure realm. Why did a demon clan with a low level of god transformation show up?
When their demon world is like a vegetable market, they can come when they want and leave when they want?
Zu Linge stared at the figure not far away and said after a moment, "He is not a demon, no, not entirely a demon. His body is a demon, but his soul is the soul of a demon."
Zu Linge made it very clear that the figure was originally a demon, but was taken away by the demons in some unknown way.
The group of demons thought they were angry enough, but when they heard Zu Linge's words, they became angry, panicked and anxious.
Anyone who sees someone from the same realm as him being taken over by someone from another realm will panic. This means that there is an undercover demon in their demon realm.
Who dares to say that this is the only undercover agent in the demon world?
They couldn't even be sure if there were any undercover demons around them at the moment.
What does demon mean? It's not enough to start a war with the cultivation world, now you're targeting their demon world, right?
I don’t even want to see if I have such a big appetite.
Their different ethnic groups fight fiercely with each other, but if someone attempts to encroach on the Demon Realm's territory, they will unite to fight against the outside world.
They really wanted to spread the news that the demon clan had an undercover agent throughout the demon world to cheer up every clan, but being trapped here, they could do nothing but worry.
Even Lin Xiao rarely showed any surprise.
title_en: Chapter 849 Zhu Mingmingjue Chapter 848 But not smart enough
